variants.name: CacheWrite
variants.description: Write vector at row position in 2D cache buffer

variants.name: Attention
variants.description: Scaled dot-product attention with GQA support

variants.name: BatchedFusedAttention
variants.description: Batched fused RoPE + CacheWrite + Attention for prefill (N tokens). NOTE: has a cross-workgroup race; prefer BatchedKVCacheWrite + BatchedAttentionReadCache.

variants.name: BatchedKVCacheWrite
variants.description: Batched RoPE(K) + K/V cache writes for N tokens. Pair with BatchedAttentionReadCache.

variants.name: BatchedAttentionReadCache
variants.description: Batched attention reading pre-populated KV cache (Q gets RoPE inline). Pair with BatchedKVCacheWrite.

variants.name: DiTAttention
variants.description: Fused non-causal multi-head attention for DiT models (online softmax, all heads in one dispatch, no score matrix)
